company.shortDescription: Eecrow is a fintech platform that combines smart contracts, escrow-based payments, and dispute resolution services.
company.description:
eecrow is a fintech platform that combines smart contracts, escrow-based payments, and dispute resolution services to create secure business transactions between freelancers, SMEs, clients, and vendors.

Its core value proposition is reducing payment risk and improving trust in digital and cross-border business engagements. The platform automates contractual obligations through enforceable smart contracts, ensuring that payments are only released when agreed milestones or deliverables are completed.

productsAndServices.description: A service that holds buyer funds securely in escrow until sellers fulfill their contractual obligations, ensuring payment is only released upon satisfactory delivery.
productsAndServices.name: Digital Escrow Payment Service

productsAndServices.description: A platform that enables users to create, manage, and track contracts and project milestones linked to escrow payments.
